Original create returns IsReplay false; pending, progressed, and terminal replays preserve Pass2ExecutionId and immutable FlowGroup/Omission/Job counts while returning IsReplay true. tests.name: Pass2Endpoints_ArePluralAndReachableThroughTheSingleCentralMapper
tests.coverage: Exactly POST create, GET status, and POST resume plural routes are registered through the one central mapper.

tests.name: PublicPass2Endpoints_Unauthenticated_Return401WithoutRedirectAsync
tests.coverage: Create/status/resume reject unauthenticated callers with 401 and no login redirect.

tests.name: AuthenticatedNonManagementUser_Create_Returns403WithoutScopeDisclosureAsync
tests.coverage: An authenticated user without management policy access receives 403 without repository/system scope leakage.

tests.name: AuthenticatedUnknownExecution_StatusAndResume_ReturnOwnershipFiltered404ProblemDetailsAsync

tests.name: Create_MissingPairAndMalformedInput_ReturnValidationProblemDetailsAsync

tests.name: Create_RejectsCallerSuppliedAuthorityScope_AsSanitizedProblemDetailsAsync
tests.coverage: Caller-supplied System, Repository, revision, provider, source, and credential fields are rejected and never echoed.

tests.name: ExecutionStateConflict_ReturnsProblemDetailsWithClosedChineseMessageAsync
tests.coverage: Resume state/concurrency conflict uses ProblemDetails, closed safe messaging, and no raw exception or stack details.

tests.name: StatusResponse_ExposesOnlySanitizedCountsAndWarningsAsync
tests.coverage: Status/error responses expose only safe accounting channels and never lease, source, provider, prompt, path, or credential atoms.

tests.name: Pass2Api_DoesNotAddStory125ChatOrProductionProgressSurface
tests.coverage: Pass 2 API registration does not introduce Chat or production progress routes; Story 12.5 UI remains excluded.
